notes.authentication: All authentication is cookie-based using HttpOnly JWT tokens. After a successful OTP verification, two cookies are automatically set on the client: 'access_token' (expires in 60 minutes) and 'refresh_token' (expires in 7 days). You do not need to manually attach these to requests — the browser does it automatically via the cookie header. Always include credentials in your fetch/axios calls (credentials: 'include' for fetch, withCredentials: true for axios).
notes.csrf: Django CSRF protection is active. For any non-GET request from a browser, you must include the CSRF token in the X-CSRFToken header. The CSRF cookie is set automatically by Django on the first request. Read it from document.cookie and attach it as a header.

permission_types.AllowAny: No authentication required. Anyone can call this endpoint.
permission_types.IsAuthenticated: Requires a valid access_token cookie. The user must be a fully approved member (has logged in at least once via OTP).
permission_types.IsPrivileged: Requires the user to be either a staff member (is_staff=true) OR a moderator of any department.
permission_types.IsAdminUser: Requires is_staff=true. Only full admins/staff can access this.
permission_types.IsSuperUser: Requires is_superuser=true. The highest privilege level, reserved for system-level operations.

user_types.unregistered: A person who has not signed up yet. They cannot log in.
user_types.pending: A member who has signed up but has not yet been approved by a moderator. They cannot log in.
user_types.approved: A member who has been accepted by a moderator. They can log in via OTP.
user_types.moderator: A member who is a moderator of at least one department. They have elevated privileges to manage posts and achievements for their department(s). Could be either head ('P') or second-in-command ('S').
user_types.staff: A member with is_staff=true. They have full admin access. Only one exits in the system.

notes.pagination: Cursor-based pagination is used on list endpoints. The response includes 'next' and 'previous' cursor URLs. Pass the cursor value via ?cursor=<value> to navigate pages.
notes.image_uploads: All image uploads must be sent as multipart/form-data. Images are validated for size (max 5MB) and checked against an NSFW filter.
